text:
alex: quick q — planning to flip inference-gateway svc from ClusterIP->NodePort + GatewayAPI TCPRoute so we can attach NLB passthrough for TLS. Any concerns with healthchecks + externalTrafficPolicy? pinging @maria for infra history

maria: are we doing TLS passthrough or terminate at ALB? If passthrough, NLB healthcheck needs targetType: ip + nodePort etc. What's current probe?

alex: current svc snippet:
```yaml
kind: Service
apiVersion: v1
metadata:
  name: inference-gateway
spec:
  type: NodePort
  externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
  ports:
    - port: 443
      targetPort: 8080
      nodePort: 32080
```

maria: if using externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster healthchecks will hit node IPs and get kube-proxy NAT -> probe may hit different node not running pod. For TLS passthrough we usually set externalTrafficPolicy: Local + hostPort/nodePort so healthcheck hits a node with pod or NLB target group uses instance target with healthy nodes only. :thinking:

josh: also consider using Gateway API TCPRoute with service backingRef port=8080. Gateway controllers differ in probe mapping. Which controller? aws-load-balancer-controller or gce?

alex: aws alb/nlb via AWS LB Controller. We want NLB for passthrough but maybe use ALB TLS termination for advanced routing.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: ensure Service has spec.healthCheckNodePort set (k8s 1.24+), or set externalTrafficPolicy: Local and targetGroupBinding with nodePort. See docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/target-group-health-checks.html

sam: if targetPort != port (8080 != 443) make sure gateway listener forwards to correct target group port. NLB when TLS passthrough preserves destination port, so nodePort must be 443 mapping to pod 8080? usually nodePort==443 not allowed without privileges, but NLB targets nodePort > 30000.

li: suggestion: keep svc NodePort, externalTrafficPolicy: Local, add readinessProbe tcpSocket: port 8080 and set nodeSelector for gateway nodes, then use NLB targetType: instance + healthcheck port nodePort. Quick sketch:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service" "gateway" {
  metadata { name = "inference-gateway" }
  spec {
    type = "NodePort"
    external_traffic_policy = "Local"
    port { port = 443; target_port = 8080; node_port = 32080 }
  }
}
```

maria: small caveat: using Local means source IP preserved but you lose load balancing across nodes; ensure enough capacity on each node, or use DaemonSet or dedicated gateway nodes.

alex: ok will prototype with Local + readiness tcp probe + annotate Service for AWS targetGroupBinding. I'll open a terraform PR and tag you all. thx :thumbsup:

josh: +1, add test plan for failover — simulate pod eviction and ensure NLB health reflects.

sam: FYI if you want TLS termination later we can switch to ALB HTTPRoute and let controller handle certs.

alex: noted, will do. ending thread for now.
